ai_summary: Accel India III (Mauritius) Ltd, a non-promoter shareholder of BlueStone Jewellery and Lifestyle Limited, sold 2.8 million equity shares through an open market transaction on September 24, 2026. This significant divestment reduced Accel's stake from 8.08% to 5.58% of the company's total voting capital. The material reduction in holding by a major institutional investor could indicate a shift in investor confidence or portfolio rebalancing, which warrants attention from the market.
